scientific_integrity.claim_scope: All finite complete 3-uniform hypergraphs with exactly three nonempty unlabelled parts, equality and one symmetric irreflexive ternary edge predicate; first-order rank at most four.
scientific_integrity.evidence: Uniform four-round classwise Duplicator strategy; exhaustive recursive Hintikka types on all twenty capped triples; independent direct and orbit-compressed finite recursions included.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No extensions to incomplete structures, variable numbers of parts, higher ranks, or independent external validation. A published or unindexed equivalent finite-model classification might exist.

title: Nine rank-four theories of complete tripartite 3-hypergraphs
